title: Move Insomnia replay application behind owner lifecycle

denominator.note: Independent Insomnia replay ownership seam split from P7.1.09 before implementation; not bundled into its parent or another child.

operations: Mutate InsomniaStore directly with apply_work or apply_attempt

cut: Move decode, exact physical append, and application of Work/Attempt records into the existing owner-lifecycle Insomnia replay helper. Keep frame ordering and the existing append-before-store-mutation order. Import retains only higher-level replay sequencing and error mapping.
preserved_contracts: Work and Attempt records are replayed in accepted physical order
The exact original payload is appended before its corresponding in-memory owner projection is changed
No duplicate/shadow Insomnia state or alternate record format is introduced
Existing Import reconciliation retry, sync, reopen, and publication behavior
preserving_tests: src/imports/reconcile_tests.rs::valid_insomnia_journal_history_is_replayed_with_completed_import asserts grouped completion Attempt projection parity without expecting current writers to emit CVAINSA1

src/owner_lifecycle/insomnia_import_replay_tests.rs::import_replay_applies_work_and_legacy_attempts_in_physical_order_across_reopen pins a test-only legacy payload through the supported decoder and verifies ordered replay, exact durable bytes, and reopened projection
Existing imports sequential completion and reconciliation suites
proof_limits: The compiler diagnostic is bounded current-profile MIR evidence, not a complete dynamic/indirect call graph.
The implementation has not yet been compiled or run through Rust tests; root owns the serialized build and integration checks.
